STATUS: CONFLICT
The lab SOP v3 note states that for hard filtering of SNPs a variant is filtered when QD < 1.5 [fx_sop_qd]. The knowledge graph gives the threshold of procedure HF-01 as QD < 2.0 for all variant types [G:Threshold:QD_lt_2] [G:Procedure:HF-01]. The two values differ, and the sources do not state which one applies.
